from-october-to-brest-litovsk: Leon Trotsky, a central leader of the 1917 Russian Revolution, gives his own account of the revolution and its aftermath. He describes the Bolshevik seizure of power and the tense negotiations that produced the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, ending Russia's part in World War I. Written by a participant at the center of events, it is history from inside the storm.
